name.en: Mukhyamantri Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
name.hi: मुख्यमंत्री एकल नारी सम्मान पेंशन योजना

description.en: A Rajasthan social security pension scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible widowed, divorced and abandoned women.

monthly_pension.note: Reported revised social security pension amount. Confirm the currently payable amount on RajSSP before presenting it as a guaranteed payment.

payment_information.bank_account_requirement: Payment is made through the state pension payment system.

additional_benefits.description: Financial assistance to eligible widowed women receiving widow pension who remarry.
eligibility: Must satisfy the applicable conditions of the Widow Remarriage Gift Scheme.
Must be an eligible widow pension beneficiary.
Must satisfy the applicable remarriage and application conditions.

application.channel: Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department

additional_benefits.note: This is a separate scheme, not an automatic addition to monthly pension.

eligibility_rules.note: Applicant must be a native resident of Rajasthan and reside in the state.
Annual income from all sources must be below ₹48,000, subject to the alternative qualifying categories specified in the rules.
These categories are alternative eligibility pathways described in the Rajasthan rules.
The rules specify exclusions involving the applicant or her son serving in or receiving pension from specified government bodies or undertakings.

instructions: Submit an application through an available official application channel.
The application is processed under the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department.
Use the official portal to check application and pension status.

auto_sanction.description: The state has described an automated, paperless application and sanction process through integrated government systems.

grievance.instructions: Register pension-related grievances through Rajasthan Sampark or call the toll-free helpline 181. Save the grievance tracking number, monitor its status, and use the reminder facility if action is delayed. Citizens can seek assistance through e-Mitra centres or the local Social Justice and Empowerment Department office.

notes: The ₹1,450 revised amount requires confirmation against the current RajSSP payable-rate table.
The ₹1,500 age-75-plus rate is based on an older official economic review and needs current confirmation.

Historical age-based slabs should not be treated as current rates without an operative government order.
